question: Who was the founder of Dharma Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Radhakanta Deb.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **founder of Dharma Sabha** was **Radhakanta Deb**, a prominent** Bengali aristocrat and intellectual** during the early **19th century.**
 
• **Dharma Sabha **was established in **1828 in Kolkata** with the aim of promoting **Hinduism **and protecting it from the influence of other religions.
 
• Radhakanta Deb was also a strong advocate for** women's education **and worked towards improving the status of **women** in society.
 
• He was a close associate of** Raja Ram Mohan Roy,** who was a prominent social reformer and played a key role in the **Bengal Renaissance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** was a prominent **social reformer** who played a key role in the **abolition of Sati **and the promotion of **women's rights **in India.
 
• **Dadoba Pandurang** was a **social reformer and educationist **from Maharashtra who played a key role in promoting** girls' education** in the region.
 
• **R.G. Bhandarkar **was an **Indian scholar and social reformer** who played a key role in the **promotion of education **and the fight against** caste discrimination.**
 
• **Radhakanta Deb** was also a close associate of** Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar,** who was another prominent social reformer and played a key role in the promotion of** women's education in Bengal.**
